title: Semantic Segmentation
description: Pixel-level prediction with FCN, U-Net, DeepLab architectures. Atrous convolution, loss functions, and post-processing.
keyTakeaways: Semantic segmentation = dense per-pixel classification; encoder extracts features, decoder restores spatial resolution
U-Net skip connections copy encoder feature maps to decoder, recovering fine spatial detail lost during downsampling
Atrous (dilated) convolution enlarges receptive field without extra parameters by inserting gaps in the kernel
Dice loss focuses on overlap between predicted and ground-truth masks; better than cross-entropy for class-imbalanced segmentation
IoU (Jaccard index) = intersection / union — the standard segmentation metric; mIoU averages across all classes
